comment: Blamsoft publish no source. configParam gives Enable 0 to 1 default 1 with an EnableParamQuantity printing Off and On, Tone 0 to 1 default 0.5 shown as 0 to 11, Distortion 0 to 1 default 0.5 shown as 0 to 11, Mix 0 to 1 default 1 shown as 0 to 100%, Level 0 to 1 default 0.75 shown as 0 to 11. Each CV jack is added to its knob at 0.1 per volt and the sum clamped to the knob's own 0 to 1 range, so a CV cannot push a control past its ends. The panel art draws a line from each jack to the knob it feeds and every one is right. Enable does not use Rack's bypass: it selects between two modes of the generated DSP, the active circuit and a delay line that matches the active path's latency, and the module runs both in parallel for a short crossfade whenever the switch changes. The maker's PDF manual was read on this pass with pypdf; it agrees throughout and is the source of the account of what the Tone filter does. The widget adds no context menu of its own. 2.0.2 is the only published build of this plugin, so no commit had to be settled.
